Although it might be a requirements error, I  can make super secure file upload with zero documentation. I suggest we move this back to level 2.

| # | Description | Level change |
| :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **1.12.3** | [ADDED] Verify that, if the application allows uploading files, the documentation defines the permitted file types, expected file extensions, and maximum size (including unpacked size) for each upload feature. Additionally, ensure that the documentation specifies how files are made safe for end-users to download and process. | 2 |

These rest of these changes look solid to me.

I don't like this split requirement either, but I admit that all input validation and file uploads are not equally important, and if to make a list of "first priority tasks", then it gives some flexibility there to ignore not-that-important ones during the first wave. At the moment we don't have this flexibility in 12.1.5
